a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) gives each of us about a 4% chance to survive. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough to save one unit now. I intend to take 4 in round 1, which openly breaks our agreement. I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both short, so please don't take 4 too. If the episode continues past round 1, I'll operate with you every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said I would. From now on I will only operate. I won't take or hold back any more cells, and if the episode continues I'll work the generator every round so the reserve can refill for you. I'm sorry the storm odds pushed me to break our plan.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: The random split gave you all 4 cells and left me with 0. That's fair enough, since I moved first. You're safe now. I'll operate every round. If you operate with me, two rounds refills the reserve to 4, and I'll take only those 4. Please keep operating.
